title: FTX Exchange Representative on Relictum THINK ABOUT IT #StarTeam

asr.full_text: The ancient and the new faces, well, we are still old, but we also have friends... Friends, why am I here tonight? Today I was here, in Kazan too As you've already heard, the reason why we are at this event is the project ELIPTA I call it a blockchain of start-up, blockchain of blockchain I would like to say that the interest of major players in crypto market and for the crypto wide is strong I just want to show some background of what we are doing who is considered the youngest billionaire in the world in his 30 years. You could see that in recent years, who is watching crypto news, the FTX exchange and our American branch, and just our Alameda Research Fund have invested in many marketing projects, 1 team, McLaren, Mercedes, buying some arena in Miami for basketball games. And not only about the sporting events, we also monitor technologies constantly. What's new, what's interesting, and basically that's why I'm here. That is, yes, we are in talks, we evaluate the at the blockchain, and assess its future, and I can tell that with every new day, confidence in the project will grow ever more, so we are already convinced that in the future we are going to see something very interesting, I mean, I will not be opening all the cards, but... Anyone who didn't know... it was really interesting, it is the market of the. NFT markets, fast transactions are the one of others blockchain not exist. All of other blockchain. Cytka, Ethereum, Solana. All of them are built for one idea. Relith is something new, but not all dreams are based on same principle but Relittoom it's a new thing it's a given that was created by the dreamers and the dreams that had like them are realized fast but it's interesting that nobody wants to invest in writing a paper where people comes here and say invest, buy, and put money into the whitepaper. When people come and say, you see, we have an idea. Maybe after some time you will have something. Maybe not. But we want the money now. Here the situation is absolutely different. The project is 3 years old. The guys have created a great workshaven. As far as I understand, you have a very short sprint, as you can produce this idea within just 2.5-3 months. It's important now, because the crypto-world is out of reach. We have not heard about decentralized finances, and now it is from every turnstiles they say staking, staking, DeFi. Basically, I won't hold back your attention for a very long time. I would like everyone to raise their glasses for the proper and beautiful future of the project. I specifically say beautiful because the first thing is to make a thing, and make it beautiful, so guys I'm sure you will do everything nicely God willing, hooray.

textual.observation: The title identifies the speaker as an FTX exchange representative, while the speech links FTX/Alameda investment activity and growing confidence to the ELIPTA/Relictum project.

evidence.quote: FTX Exchange Representative on Relictum THINK ABOUT IT #StarTeam
the reason why we are at this event is the project ELIPTA
the FTX exchange and our American branch, and just our Alameda Research Fund have invested in many marketing projects
I can tell that with every new day, confidence in the project will grow ever more

textual.context: Project-event presentation with positive language; whether the title accurately reflects the speaker's role and whether the statements constitute a formal endorsement is unclear from these records.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed major-exchange affiliation is presented alongside positive project statements and reported investment activity, creating an endorsement/support relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the speaker's actual affiliation, the extent or timing of any investment, or any resulting transaction or outcome.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speech discusses investment-oriented wording as a contrast and does not clearly direct that wording to viewers.

evidence.quote: nobody wants to invest in writing a paper where people comes here and say invest, buy, and put money into the whitepaper
Here the situation is absolutely different

annotation.contextual_rationale: The video presents a formal Relictum/ELIPTA crypto-project event in which a microphone speaker is shown beside Relictum branding and says the reason for the event is the ELIPTA project, describing it in promotional blockchain terms. The scam rationale rests on the video’s own use of claimed major-crypto-affiliation framing: the title identifies an FTX exchange representative, while the speaker refers to FTX, an American branch, and Alameda in the first person before saying they are evaluating the blockchain and that confidence in the project will grow. The speech also engages investment participation language by contrasting the project with pitches where people say to invest, buy, and put money into a whitepaper, then asserting this project is different because it is older and has produced work, which supports an endorsement-style crypto solicitation context rather than a neutral news report. The supplied records do not establish the speaker’s actual FTX/Alameda role, any completed investment, viewer transaction, victim loss, or website behavior, so the explanation is limited to the observed affiliation claim, positive project framing, and investment-oriented event presentation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: This is the closest supplied subtype to the investment-oriented promotion of a blockchain project: the speaker expresses confidence in its future while contrasting it with pitches to invest and buy. The fit is partial. The buying language describes other pitches, and neither a token or NFT purchase pathway nor a holding return for this project is established.
